scope: E01-E08 evidence-based first pass; E09 onwards incomplete

policy.pair_specific: A direct pair record must have a named actor/observer related to that pair.
policy.group_context: Group situations are flagged and do not prove individual touch or knowledge.
policy.status: Requests, thoughts, reports, visual observations, accidental visibility and contact remain separate.
policy.ep8_68: E08 source indexed and narrative first pass. E09–E68 not complete; E08 Skype continues to E09.

state_milestones.title: Initial pair state after shared ride
established: Bantu initiates frequent compliments and requests a ride
Dhika agrees to transport both twins
Bantu sits behind Bobby, with a disappointed reaction
Bantu sees Bobby looking during the walk but is not told the later details of Bobby's ride contact
not_established: Bantu did not perform Bobby's ride contact
Bobby's unshared details are not Bantu's knowledge

state_milestones.title: Bobby and Dhika after first ride
established: Bobby initially observes exposed skin at Dhika's hip while in the staff room (L81–82)
During the ride, Bobby holds Dhika around her waist/stomach rather than her expected shoulder support (L96–100)
Dhika notices continuing hand movement at the side of her hip and feels uncomfortable (L102–103)
Bobby keeps the specific ride details from Bantu (L108)
not_established: The practical balance invitation is not general permission for other physical actions
Bantu is not a direct participant in the Bobby-specific contact

established: The twins arrange extra physics tuition with Dhika

Bantu averts his gaze during the incident (L356)
Dhika withdraws, then returns, and Bantu concludes the visit rapidly (L356–363)
Dhika worries privately and speaks to John later; Bantu is absent for that talk
not_established: Bantu caused the clothing incident
The later conversation with John is a second encounter with Bantu

state_milestones.title: Reaction after accidental home incident
established: Bobby contributes to the tuition request and helps open the apartment door
The sari-drape slip is accidental and temporarily reveals part of Dhika's upper chest (L352–355)
Bobby is reported as continuing to look during the incident (L356)
When Dhika returns from the other room, Bobby has already left; his later thoughts are not established

The twins are later notified that a class will be skipped (L993–994)
not_established: Bobby was present during Bantu's separate shopping visit

not_established: Bobby attended Bantu's solo shopping encounter

Bobby thinks of later telling Bantu what happened; this is intention, not confirmation (L1198)

established: Bantu visits alone to arrange lessons during travel (L1370–1384)

not_established: Bobby was present at Monday's Bantu-only visit
A requested or imagined action automatically happened
The remote call ended during E07

state_milestones.title: Bobby attends remote lesson, not solo visit
established: Bobby is spoken about during Monday's Bantu-only visit; his presence is not established (L1375–1376, L1434–1435)

established: E07 shared video lesson is closed during E08 (L1544–1552), not duplicated as another video lesson

state_milestones.title: Call closure, apology and new one-to-one Skype conversation
established: The E07 group call finishes in E08; Bobby witnesses the abrupt end, but Dhika's private reasons are not fully shared (L1544–1562)

not_established: Bobby joined the Bantu in-person meeting
A remote video exchange is in-person physical contact
The final action of the Skype exchange is known by E08 alone
Bobby's unspoken motivations are all known to Dhika

writing_map.title: Opening: dialogue against narrator-established personalities
writing_map.narration: Bantu's recurring greeting and Dhika's embarrassment are set against the narrator's explanation that the twins interact differently.
writing_map.speech: Bantu leads, Dhika replies, Bobby is present but not the initiator.
writing_map.private_thought: Dhika's earlier discomfort versus more recent expectation is narrated; it is not spoken to Bantu.
writing_map.who_knows: Reader knows her shift in attitude; Bantu's knowledge of that private change is not demonstrated.

writing_map.title: Ride: practical request versus undisclosed motive
writing_map.narration: The outward request is separated from the narrator's account of what Bantu intended, then from Bobby's actions.
writing_map.speech: Ride request, seat arrangement and thanks are shared dialogue.
writing_map.private_thought: Bobby's private preferences and Bantu's disappointment are given separately.
writing_map.who_knows: A detail Bobby withholds from Bantu must not be inserted into Bantu's timeline as personal knowledge.
writing_map.sequence: Request → assent → seating → distinct observations/actions → goodbye and withheld information.

writing_map.title: Academic conversation builds a new visit routine
writing_map.narration: Prior ride recollection precedes a new request; academic motivation and narrator-reported pretexts are differentiated.
writing_map.speech: Bantu introduces goal, Bobby contributes, Dhika agrees and specifies days and time.
writing_map.private_thought: Dhika considers her time commitments and trust in the students.
writing_map.who_knows: Her private schedule concerns are not automatically known to the twins.
writing_map.sequence: Greeting → E01 memory → request → clarification → permission → schedule.

writing_map.title: Unexpected incident, diverging reactions and time-jump aftermath
writing_map.narration: A falling bag causes the sari drape to slip unexpectedly; the narrative tracks separate visible reactions and later worry.
writing_map.speech: The twins end the visit quickly, followed by a later conversation with John.
writing_map.private_thought: Dhika's worry about reputation and future meetings is her state, not a confirmed shared fear.
writing_map.who_knows: John learns from Dhika's later report; he is not present at the original home incident. Bobby and Bantu react differently.
writing_map.sequence: Travel → entry → accident → clothing restored → separate reactions → departure → private worry → third-party retelling.

writing_map.title: One-on-one dialogue with a timed interruption
writing_map.narration: The author juxtaposes Bobby's timid manner with his increased willingness to speak during a subject he enjoys.
writing_map.speech: Competition request, encouragement and study conversation move the scene.
writing_map.private_thought: Bobby's private reason for visiting and Dhika's intention to help him converse are separately narrated.
writing_map.who_knows: Neither party is explicitly told the other's complete private reasoning.
writing_map.sequence: Arrival → offer and request → study → uncomfortable pauses → Chotu's doorbell.

writing_map.title: Group arrival requires attribution reset
writing_map.narration: The speaker and participant count change when Chotu arrives; practical help after an accident is allocated to the people who actually act.
writing_map.speech: Introductions, Bobby's request to stay and Dhika's consent precede painting.
writing_map.private_thought: Some reactions are narrated, not communicated to everyone in the room.
writing_map.who_knows: Bobby's actions must not inherit Chotu's later private events after he leaves.
writing_map.sequence: Introductions → permission → painting → accidental fall → separate assistance → Bobby exits.

writing_map.title: Arrival and logistics: speech versus concealed motivation
writing_map.narration: A routine travel notice turns into an online-tuition arrangement. A narrated motive about choosing video is not communicated as dialogue.
writing_map.speech: Bantu asks for remote lessons and Dhika offers a video option.
writing_map.private_thought: The narrator supplies Bantu's expectation about a webcam at L1382; Dhika cannot be assumed to know that thought.
writing_map.who_knows: Bobby is described as packing elsewhere, not participating in Monday's exchange.
writing_map.sequence: Unexpected solo arrival → trip explanation → lesson request → webcam suggestion → Wednesday agreement.

writing_map.title: Back-and-forth pacing of questions and limits
writing_map.narration: Quick dialogue, hesitations, private reactions, and several responses are interleaved.
writing_map.speech: Requests and refusals are repeated; an initial hesitation is not the same as later completed action.
writing_map.private_thought: The reader gets Dhika's uncertainty and Bantu's reactions; their private states should not be merged.
writing_map.who_knows: Reported accounts of third parties in dialogue remain speaker claims, not independently established facts.
writing_map.sequence: Teasing → reactions → questions → requests and refusals → boundaries.

writing_map.title: Gift negotiation: consent to object, not every later request
writing_map.narration: The scene turns from conversational teasing into an object-based interaction; the narration records reluctant acceptance.
writing_map.speech: Gift offer, teacher-role objection, reported explanation, renewed refusal, insistence, and eventual acceptance are individually observable beats.
writing_map.private_thought: Dhika's later speculation about Bobby at L1464 is a private hypothesis.
writing_map.who_knows: Bantu's account of his mother's role is his statement; it need not be treated as independently witnessed.
writing_map.sequence: Offer → objection → explanation → refusal → pressure → reluctant acceptance → further request.

writing_map.title: End of solo visit followed by private callback
writing_map.scene_frame: Monday departure then Wednesday home preparation
writing_map.narration: The scene closes as Bantu leaves; Wednesday shifts to Dhika alone, recalling earlier advice.
writing_map.speech: Closing dialogue includes suggestions, responses, and a goodbye.
writing_map.private_thought: A previous remark reappears in Dhika's memory while she prepares; it is not a second meeting.
writing_map.who_knows: Bantu is not present when the private recollection occurs.
writing_map.sequence: Final exchange → departure → time jump → solitary recall → remote call begins.

writing_map.title: Remote group scene: academic task → group response → open boundary
writing_map.scene_frame: Wednesday video call, both twins present remotely
writing_map.narration: Technical competition information and study discussion give way to short exchanges, group reactions, and a sudden unanswered question.
writing_map.speech: Bobby explains the competition, Bantu brings up the gift, Bobby confirms one comment, and Dhika addresses both.
writing_map.private_thought: Dhika's intention at L1525 is narrated; it is not necessarily the twins' understanding.
writing_map.who_knows: Each twin's spoken words belong to that speaker. The online meeting remains active at the E07/E08 transition.
writing_map.sequence: Greetings → Bobby academic explanation → study → shared conversation → group reaction → screen check; same encounter continues E08.

writing_map.title: Cross-episode cut: E07 call closes before new visit
writing_map.narration: The writer resumes a scene at the exact action interrupted by the chapter boundary, then uses a sudden change of tone, call termination and a private reflection.
writing_map.speech: Dhika addresses Bantu and announces a schedule change before disconnecting; both twins hear that part.
writing_map.private_thought: Her concern and later reassessment are narrated while she is alone, not spoken during the call.
writing_map.who_knows: Bobby and Bantu observe a sudden reaction; they cannot automatically know Dhika's subsequent internal reasoning.
writing_map.sequence: Video reaction → question → group call ends → private interpretation → time passes.

writing_map.title: Repair structure: uncertain arrival to explicit reassurance
writing_map.narration: The new meeting begins after a time jump. Apology, corrected assumption, fear of reputation damage, reassurance and a potential future-trip report each add a separate change of tone.
writing_map.speech: Bantu asks what happened, Dhika apologizes and explains, Bantu voices trust, then mentions an anticipated travel role.
writing_map.private_thought: Dhika's uncertainty about accompanying the students is internal, not a commitment.
writing_map.who_knows: Bantu only knows what Dhika explains. His report about Bobby is not a direct Bobby speech act.
writing_map.sequence: New arrival → greeting → apology → corrected assumption → trust dialogue → reported plan.

writing_map.title: Conversation then accident: distinct intentions and assistance
writing_map.narration: The narrative shifts from light conversation to an unexpected fall. It distinguishes an accident, practical help, and a subsequent action rather than calling them all one incident.
writing_map.speech: Dhika gives stopping cues and later ends the visit to collect Pappu. Bantu answers with his Friday availability plan.
writing_map.private_thought: The participants' private interpretations are shown at different moments; one should not replace the other's.
writing_map.who_knows: The source establishes both the assistance and a separate later movement; inference of blanket permission would be unsupported.
writing_map.sequence: Dialogue → objection and response → slip → help → further boundary → departure.

writing_map.title: Phone apology to Skype: two modalities, one cliffhanger
writing_map.scene_frame: Dhika phones Bobby; later Bobby starts a Skype call
writing_map.narration: A single sentence records the phone apology, then a fresh time/location setting establishes a later video call. The author alternates Bobby's shyness with a new willingness to speak.
writing_map.speech: The video conversation includes requests, clarification and conditions, without settling its last unresolved moment.
writing_map.private_thought: The text identifies Bobby's hesitation and Dhika's separate reactions, but does not make those private thoughts common knowledge.
writing_map.who_knows: The final reaction at the E08 boundary is not enough to establish the action that E09 describes next.
writing_map.sequence: Apology phone call → new Skype ringing → connection → back-and-forth dialogue → condition → cliffhanger → E09 continuation.
